subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Tracing the origin of horse domestication in the prehistoric era have proven to be an exceedingly difficult task.

options.text: Tracing the origin of horse domestication
in the prehistoric era have proven
to be an exceedingly difficult task.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**have**" used with a singular subject.
 
• The subject of the sentence "**Tracing the origin of horse domestication in the prehistoric era**" is singular and therefore should take the singular verb "**has**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**in the prehistoric era has proven**," ensuring grammatical correctness and subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Tracing the origin of horse domestication in the prehistoric era **has** proven to be an exceedingly difficult task."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Tracing the origin of horse domestication,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 3.
 
• **Option 4: "to be an exceedingly difficult task."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
